title: Checkout DB pool exhaustion after deploy
description: Classic post-deploy connection pool exhaustion cascading into the API gateway.
raw_input:

2026-04-14T10:02:03Z [checkout-svc] ERROR latency p99 > 8s

2026-04-14T10:08:55Z [checkout-svc] INFO rolling back to v411
